ms.report:
ADDENDUM

So, the Purus project accomplishes this essential task: compiling Purescript code to CoreFn (native to Purescript compiler) then compiling CoreFn to PIR. Compare this with the normal Plutus compilation pipeline which compiles Plutus to PIR directly. This is key, because from PIR its only a few steps to UPLC which is the language the Cardano blockchain understands and executes.

Purus :: Purescript -> CoreFn -> PIR -> PLC -> UPLC
Plutus :: Plutus -> PIR -> PLC -> UPLC

So, its likely best to present our evidence in reverse order:
